mechanism: Infliximab increases infection risk by suppressing TNF-alpha-mediated immune responses, while amphotericin B is nephrotoxic and can cause electrolyte abnormalities that may compound immunosuppression and increase susceptibility to invasive fungal infections.
action: Use combination only when treating documented fungal infections in TNF-inhibitor patients; monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of infection closely; consider alternative antifungal agents with better renal safety profiles when possible.
